component.name: Finly
component.summary: Modern personal finance and transaction tracker

description.p: Finly is a modern, privacy-focused desktop application designed to help you take control of your financial life. Track accounts, monitor daily transactions, categorize your expenses and income, configure budgets, and import bank statements with smart column detection.

ul.li: Interactive Dashboard with real-time cash flow metrics
Transaction Management with filtering, search, and category tracking
Smart CSV statement import with custom column mapping and multi-format amount parsing
Budget targets with visual threshold tracking
Custom category creation, editing, and reassignment
Local SQLite database keeping all your personal data completely private

description.p: Initial release with dashboard, transaction management, category management, budget tracking, and CSV import.
